mongo.operation: find with an empty filter and an inclusion projection (no customer fields)

methods: spreadsheets.values.get (row 1 and the Mongo ID column)

limitations: Read-only: MongoDB find and Google Sheets spreadsheets.get / values.get only. Nothing is queued, written or repaired.
Sheets are read first, then MongoDB. The reads are not a snapshot: a record saved within one drain cycle (about five minutes) of the read can show as missing.
Master Sheets only. Source Company Sheets and the retired titles Duplicates, Bad Leads and Bad Calls are not read.
Expected tabs come from the server's planExpectedSheetTabs over raw stored flags; the drainer reads the same flags through Mongoose.
Rows with a blank Mongo ID cell (managed cells cleared, operator content kept) are counted, not classified.
Calls and Duplicate Calls are Owner-managed (Owner directive, November 20): report only, no repair suggestion.
evidence_note: Single Owner-scoped production read-only run (branch feat/sheet-sync-profile-and-reconcile, before the PR). Command: pnpm --silent vantage -- sheet-sync reconcile --production-read --samples 400 --json. After the run, read_plan.mongo.target (Atlas cluster host) and read_plan.env_file (absolute local path) were redacted here; the CLI now redacts both itself. Contents are Mongo IDs, row numbers, ObjectId creation times, ingestion origins and reason codes only; no customer field was read from Mongo and only the header row and Mongo ID column were read from Sheets.
